bib.title: Not All LLM Reasoners Are Created Equal

question: How deep is LLMs' grade-school math reasoning when two GSM8K questions are chained so the second depends on the first answer?
hypothesis: A model that solves Q1 and Q2 independently with accuracies S1 and S2 should score S1*S2 on the chained problem.
contributions: Compositional GSM: two-hop chaining of GSM8K test questions at same difficulty
Reasoning-gap measure across ~23 open and closed LLMs
Analysis of size/cost, instruction tuning, math specialization, finetuning overfitting, code vs NL, leakage and distraction

method.summary: Pairs of GSM8K test questions are chained (Q1 answer becomes variable X in a modified Q2). Models are evaluated 8-shot at temperature 0 on original, modified and compositional sets; the gap is S_comp - S1*S2. Extra experiments: rejection finetuning of Gemma2 27B PT, code-vs-CoT prompting.
method.task: grade-school math word problems, compositional two-hop

datasets.name: Modified GSM8K (Q2 set)
datasets.source: a number in Q2 replaced by X; new answer a positive integer near old; computed by editing code-form solutions from Gao et al. 2023; 16 samples each from GPT-4o and Gemini 1.5 Pro, dropped if fewer than 4 of 16 agree, manual check/edit about 25%

datasets.name: GSM8K train
datasets.size: not stated (full train set, inferred from 'all GSM8K training queries')
datasets.preprocessing: rejection finetuning: 10 solutions per question from Gemma2 27B PT 8-shot, keep correct

training.objective: supervised finetuning on GSM8K human solutions, or on self-generated correct solutions (rejection finetuning)

other.note: Only Gemma2 27B PT is trained; hyperparameters not given

inference.prompting: standard 8-shot for original/modified; 8-shot compositional prompt; 8-shot code prompt (two functions solve_q1, solution). Optional preamble prefixed; both with and without tested, best reported.

metrics.name: pass@1 accuracy
metrics.definition: fraction correct, single greedy sample; compositional requires final Q2 answer correct

metrics.name: reasoning gap
metrics.definition: S_comp - S1*S2, where S1 is accuracy on Q1 (original) set and S2 on modified Q2 set

eval.protocol: single run per model; no seeds or significance tests; Fig 1 x-axis is sqrt(S1*S2)

prompts.text: I am going to give you a series of demonstrations of math Problems and Solutions. When you respond, respond only with the Solution of the final Problem, thinking step by step. At the end of the Solution, when you give your final answer, write it in the form “The final answer is ANSWER.”

I am going to give you a series of demonstrations of compositional math questions and solutions. Respond by thinking step by step. Solve the first question and write the intermediate answer as “The Q1 answer is ANSWER1.“ Then solve Q2. At the end of the solution, when you give your final answer, write it in the form “The final answer is ANSWER2.”
Write two functions ‘solve_q1‘ and ‘solution‘ to solve Q1 and Q2 problems.

results.claim: Instruction tuning on small models helps GSM8K much more than compositional GSM (e.g. LLAMA3-8B +25.1 vs +12.6); for large models the pattern reverses (LLAMA3-70B +8.6 vs +19.0).
Mistral-7B IT gains: +14.1 GSM8K but +4.3 compositional.
Gemma2-9B IT gains: +22.8 GSM8K but +4.8 compositional.
Finetuning Gemma2 27B PT on GSM8K: compositional accuracy rises up to 100 steps then drops at 400 while GSM8K keeps improving (task overfitting); synthetic (rejection-sampled) data beats human data.
results.setup: Gemma2 27B PT, human vs self-generated solutions
results.quote: compositional GSM performance increases with some training (up to 100 steps), but drops with more training steps (400 steps) while GSM8K test performance keeps increasing

results.claim: Generating Python code instead of NL CoT helps small models more on compositional GSM (relative gains: Mistral 7B +149%, Mixtral +71%; LLAMA3 8B +69%, 70B +2%; Gemma2 9B +74%, 27B +27%).

results.claim: Modified (Q2) GSM8K questions are solved at about the original rate, so test-set leakage is not the main cause of the gap.

results.claim: Models are distracted by having Q2 in the prompt: several solve Q1 less often in compositional format than standalone, and fail on Q2 even after correct Q1 (poor second hop).

results.quote: We checked these questions manually and modified them if needed so that they are logical (about 25% of questions).

limits: Authors say it is a case study, not a new benchmark to be solved.
Single run, temperature 0, no confidence intervals; 1200 items only.
Hyperparameters of the finetuning experiment are not given; dataset and code release not stated.
Leakage conclusion rests on Q1 vs modified-Q2 accuracy similarity, which is indirect.
Figure-derived numbers (gaps, deltas) are not in a table; models are mid-2024 and dated.
Gap definition S1*S2 assumes independence of the two hops.
